title: Certifiability-aware defensive correction for adaptive particle allocation

mean_only_gate_limit.statement: For the full aggressive correction q1, a 5% promotion threshold was not reachable on the tested gradual-drift validation paths. On 40 q0-only paths the extremal affine mean-only e-wealth ended in approximately [10.00,12.095], below 20; even the pathwise clairvoyant affine upper construction did not exceed 12.095.
mean_only_gate_limit.interpretation: This is pathwise evidence, not a population impossibility theorem. Under a null specified only by finitely many conditional constraints, the public complete-class result says valid e-processes are pointwise dominated by predictable products of affine one-step e-variables, so merely replacing the mean-only e-process family is not the promising bottleneck.

hard_trust_region_theorem.objective: V(q;A)=sum_i A_i/q_i for A_i>=0 and simplex allocation q
hard_trust_region_theorem.condition: q_c,i >= q_0,i / rho for every i
hard_trust_region_theorem.guarantee: V(q_c;A) <= rho * V(q_0;A) for every nonnegative A
hard_trust_region_theorem.proof_sketch: The ratio is a weighted average of q_0,i/q_c,i with nonnegative weights proportional to A_i/q_0,i, hence it is bounded by max_i q_0,i/q_c,i <= rho.
hard_trust_region_theorem.robust_proxy_optimizer: min_q sum_i center_i/q_i subject to sum_i q_i=1 and q_i>=q_0,i/rho
hard_trust_region_theorem.kkt_solution: q_c,i=max(q_0,i/rho, c*sqrt(center_i)), with scalar c chosen so the entries sum to one.

heterogeneous_cost_extension.objective: If q_i is a cost share and one particle at generation i costs k_i, then N_i=C q_i/k_i and V=(1/C)sum_i A_i k_i/q_i.
heterogeneous_cost_extension.same_hard_cap: The identical floor q_c,i>=q_0,i/rho still gives V(q_c;A)<=rho V(q_0;A).

promotion_e_process.proxy_loss: ell(q,d)=(1/T) sum_i d_i/q_i for completed simplex diagnostic d
promotion_e_process.validity_scope: Under E[Delta_t | past]>=0 at every checked pre-promotion time, e_t is nonnegative and has conditional mean <=1, so its predictable product is an anytime-valid admission test.
promotion_e_process.semantic_boundary: Rejecting the historical null does not certify the next run under arbitrary drift. The deterministic rho floor is the per-run relative-risk layer; the e-process is an admission/efficiency layer.

post_promotion_harm_monitor.purpose: Use e-SR/e-detector semantics for repeated harm monitoring so long good prefixes do not permanently bankrupt fresh harm evidence.
post_promotion_harm_monitor.boundary: ARL-style false-alarm control is distinct from a global ever-false-alarm PFA guarantee.

synthetic_discovery.model: 12-generation two-state Feynman-Kac model; independent stratified resampling; 768 particles/run; continuation-CV2 diagnostic; exact post-hoc A available only for evaluation.
synthetic_discovery.selection_rule: Most aggressive discovery candidate whose recurring exact post-hoc transient ratio remained <=1.10 on the discovery streams.
synthetic_discovery.note: The discovery transient rule selected rho for this synthetic experiment; the algebraic rho cap itself does not depend on this validation.

proxy_bridge_diagnostics.interpretation: Proxy alignment is strong in this synthetic model but is not a theorem; recurring drift shows historical admission evidence can be stale.

new_true_objective_bridge_candidate.identity: For two conditionally independent unbiased scalar estimators Zhat_q^(1), Zhat_q^(2) of the same target Z, E[(Zhat_q^(1)-Zhat_q^(2))^2/2 | past]=Var(Zhat_q | past).
new_true_objective_bridge_candidate.use: Sparse replicated subclouds can therefore provide a direct high-fidelity variance-comparison stream without knowing Z or relying on the continuation proxy.
new_true_objective_bridge_candidate.cost_and_limit: A naive label needs four independent estimator replicas; if estimator range bounds are very loose the anytime test can be statistically inefficient. This is a frontier candidate, not yet promoted.

negative_evidence: Trying to certify the full aggressive q1 at alpha=0.05 produced no promotions in the tested abrupt, gradual, or recurring validation streams.

A scalar blend trust controller selected on discovery failed the intended recurring validation transient cap, reaching about 1.1136, so it was rejected in favor of the exact floor-constrained optimizer.
A proxy admission certificate is not a next-run true-variance certificate under arbitrary drift; indistinguishable histories can be followed by opposite next-step conditional means.
The replicated-subcloud variance identity is exact, but naive bounded e-values may be too conservative when the estimator's deterministic range is large.

frontier: Evaluate the replicated-subcloud true-variance label under defensive bounded outputs, including cost-normalized information rate and whether sample-variance/U-statistic batches beat the four-replica construction.

For bounded second-moment information, derive the optimal two-constraint affine one-step e-variable and test whether it materially shortens the current promotion delay; do not expect nonlinear mean-only betting to solve the bottleneck.
Generalize the deterministic rho trust region beyond separable sum_i A_i/q_i objectives; identify conditions for dependent resampling covariance terms.
For heterogeneous wall-clock costs, validate the exact floor-constrained sqrt(center_i*k_i) allocation and choose rho directly from an operator risk budget rather than synthetic transient tuning.
exact_next_action: Implement sparse replicated-subcloud calibration on the same stratified 12-generation synthetic PF: obtain two independent normalizing-constant estimates under q0 and qc per arm, form the unbiased variance-difference label, measure its range/variance and 5% anytime certification delay under rho=1.03. In parallel, test whether the Kostov-Whiteley unbiased second-moment construction can supply the same label more cheaply under the current resampling assumptions.
